generation_question_only: The FET was placed at the proximal end of the left vertebral artery, with a 10 mm diameter fenestration; after securing the graft, it was repositioned to the distal end of the left vertebral artery for proximal anastomosis with a 25 mm FDPA graft. The proximal FDPA was then replaced with a 30 mm FDPA graft, which was secured with a 6-0 dura mater sutures.
